parsed.post: New best! val_bpb improved from 1.0248 to 1.0110. The current configuration is performing well. I'll now experiment with increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to improve local context modeling and slightly increasing the learning rate to push convergence further.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 and slightly increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.07 to enhance local context and convergence speed.
